title: NCBI symbols under another database name before release 100
what: Ensembl files the NCBI symbols under `EntrezGene` up to 87 and `NCBI gene` from 88 to 99, and under `NCBI gene (formerly Entrezgene)` from 100 on; a symbol asked under its name of 100 at an earlier release is not found
user_action: ask for the database by its name at the release asked (`final_databases(release)`)

title: an accession version never had is answered with its gene
what: every version of a RefSeq or UniProt accession is cut, so a version the accession never had in the window answers the accession's gene
user_action: drop accession versions you cannot vouch for, or check them against the database

title: an old accession version is read at the target
what: an accession version had at an older release is read at the target release without its version
user_action: ask an old accession version with the release it belongs to (`from_release`)

title: RFAM labels written as the accession
what: at some releases Ensembl writes an RFAM entry's accession as its label: the label line expects the accession's string; the truth should expect the entry's genes
fixed_by: none (the judge: a revision of the truth, not yet published)

title: a string that another database also gives the gene
what: the string is also a value or name of the returned gene in another database at the release read; without `from_database` it names both

title: a value attached through another object form
what: Ensembl attaches the value to the gene through an object (gene, transcript, translation) other than the one the externals configuration reads the database from

title: no successor in Ensembl's history: a bridge through a shared id
what: Ensembl's history has no successor and the answer lies elsewhere (no explained path in the sample)

title: a database the graph does not hold at the release
what: the externals configuration does not hold the database at the assembly of the release asked
user_action: ask at a release whose assembly holds it (`final_databases(release)`)

title: wrong answers without a cause, read one by one
what: answers no test of the classifier explains (docs/families/c.md, "Causes")
